CallRoom.title: CallRoom
CallRoom.description: Represents a 1-on-1 video call room with WebRTC signaling and participant media states.

roomCode.description: Unique 4-16 character alphanumeric room code matching document ID.

roomTitle.description: Display title of the video call session.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room creator/host.

guestUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the joined guest, or empty string if waiting.

guestName.description: Display name of the guest, or empty string if waiting.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the call room.

hostMuted.description: Whether the host microphone is muted.

hostCameraOn.description: Whether the host camera is active.

hostScreenSharing.description: Whether the host is sharing their screen.

guestMuted.description: Whether the guest microphone is muted.

guestCameraOn.description: Whether the guest camera is active.

guestScreenSharing.description: Whether the guest is sharing their screen.

sdpOffer.description: WebRTC SDP offer or signaling state payload from host.

sdpAnswer.description: WebRTC SDP answer or signaling state payload from guest.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when room was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when room was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ReactionEvent.title: ReactionEvent
ReactionEvent.description: Real-time AI gesture or manual emoji reaction synced across both call participants.

roomId.description: Room code ID where the reaction occurred.

senderUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the participant who triggered the reaction.

gestureType.description: Detected CV gesture or manual reaction type.

emoji.description: Primary emoji symbol rendered in the particle burst.

source.description: Whether triggered by MediaPipe/CV landmark detection or manual fallback bar.

originX.description: Normalized horizontal origin (0 to 100) for particle burst.

originY.description: Normalized vertical origin (0 to 100) for particle burst.

allowedUids.description: Bounded list (1-2 elements) of participant UIDs authorized to read this reaction.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when reaction was emitted (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/rooms/{roomId}.description: 1-on-1 video call rooms indexed by roomCode.

/rooms/{roomId}/reactions/{reactionId}.description: Append-only stream of live gesture and facial expression emoji reactions.
